title: Peripheral and central venous access
summary: Cannulate a vein using a vein finder, and plan a Seldinger central line.

steps.title: Explain the cannula
steps.prompt: Do I really need another needle?

choices.text: I need a drip to give you fluids and medicines. It's a sharp scratch, and I'll use this light to find a good vein first.

choices.feedback: Explain why and what to expect.

steps.title: Find a vein with the vein finder
steps.hint: Near-infrared light shows the veins under the skin.

steps.title: Pick up the skin preparation
steps.hint: Alcoholic chlorhexidine, applied from the incision site outwards.

steps.title: Prepare the skin over the chosen vein
steps.hint: Centre outwards, wider than the incision; let it dry fully before drapes and diathermy (it is flammable).

steps.title: Take the cannula
steps.hint: Bevel up, 15–30°; watch for flashback, then advance the cannula off the needle.

steps.title: Cannulate the vein
steps.hint: Flashback, lower, advance a few mm, slide the cannula in.

steps.title: Flush the cannula
steps.hint: Saline flush: no swelling, no pain.

steps.title: Open the infusion pump door and load the line
steps.hint: Check drug, dose, rate and line against the prescription.

steps.title: Central line
steps.prompt: During a Seldinger central line insertion you must…

choices.text: Never let go of the guidewire
choices.feedback: Correct: a lost wire can embolise.
The dilator goes over the wire.
